notes: Account background: mid-size division of a global financial data provider — heavy regulatory/compliance needs.
Primary pain: current hybrid search (BM25 + simple cosine) returns stale results on high-cardinality filters; cross-encoder rerank too slow/costly.
Indexing scale: expecting 80-140M "vectors" over 12 months; average vector dim target 1536; metadata per vector ~1KB.
Throughput / latency targets: 400 sustained QPS with bursts to 1k QPS; 95th-latency target for top-k retrieval + rerank < 250ms (goal <150ms).
Cost sensitivity: looking for <$0.01 total cost/query (embedding + retrieval + rerank) at scale; willing to trade small latency for 2x cost reduction.
Vector DB evaluation: Pinecone (managed, good HA) vs Weaviate (modular, plugin rerank) vs pgvector (control, cheaper infra) vs Elastic (single infra, ops heavy).
Customer quote: "We need predictable TCO for 100M+ rows — unpredictable billing is the dealbreaker."
Ingest details: nightly bulk ingest from Snowflake (50M rows/day peak) + near-real-time CDC for high-value docs (secs latency).
Rerank approach: retrieval-phase with ANN -> candidate set (k=100) then cross-encoder rerank on dedicated GPU pool; want Redwood to host rerank or provide tight integration API.
Tenanting: multi-tenant index segregation required; separate namespaces per business unit + audit trails per namespace.
Data residency: EU customer subset must remain in eu-central; asking about hybrid control plane with private control plane option.
SE notes: need benchmark harness (we will provide synthetic dataset similar to customer corpora) and scripts for: recall@10, latency p50/p95, ops/sec for upserts.
Potential win: Redwood Dedicated with managed Weaviate connector + hosted rerank GPU pool — balances control and cost predictability.
Risk: pgvector looked appealing for price but team flagged reindex nightmares and operational overhead for 100M+ vectors.

Ask on connector features: bulk upsert, streaming upsert, upsert throughput targets (200k vectors/hour), vector-dim auto-detect, hybrid search (BM25+ANN), server-side filtering on metadata, consistent snapshot export, TTL support.
Legal: NDA signed; waiting on infosec questionnaire (Q: KMS key management – customer wants BYOK option).
Notes style: fragments are ok; add pricing deck link when shared.
indexing_scale_summary: Target index: 80M–140M vectors (1536 dim). Peak nightly bulk adds ~50M vectors; steady-state CDC for 10–20k updates/day.
latency_targets: Retrieval (ANN) p50 <60ms, p95 <150ms; retrieval + cross-encoder rerank end-to-end p95 <250ms (goal <150ms).
cost_constraints: Total cost/query target <$0.01 at scale. Priority: predictable unit economics; prefer flat reserved capacity pricing over per-op surprises.

EU region pinning + ability to export/import snapshots for relocation

HNSW/ANN index tuning exposed (efConstruction, M) and compact quantization options for cost/latency tradeoffs
